problems.criteria: Per-frame body frame axes (x_body, y_body, z_body) are computed and orthonormalized; R_rel = R_bed^T * R_body is computed and converted to quaternion.
problems.issue: BuildBodyFrameFromPose uses shoulders−pelvis as z_axis and computes y via cross; x_axis uses right_hip−left_hip, which is the opposite of required right_hip→left_hip, and z_body is not defined as x_body × y_body. This does not follow the specified body-frame definition or Gram-Schmidt orthonormalization.
problems.evidence: get_pose_indemind_left.cpp BuildBodyFrameFromPose: z_raw = shoulders - pelvis; x_raw = rh - lh; y_axis = z_axis.cross(x_axis).
problems.impact: Body frame axes are misassigned; quaternion, Euler angles, and flip/twist/side measurements are incorrect.

problems.criteria: Per-axis rotation angles (about x/y/z body axes) are derived and cumulative rotation is tracked to compute flip/twist/side-flip counts.
problems.issue: Metrics map counts as [x,z,y], swapping twist/side relative to the spec (twist should be about y_body, side about z_body).
problems.evidence: get_pose_indemind_left.cpp metrics panel: Counts (flip/twist/side): [counts[0], counts[2], counts[1]].

required_changes: Define y_body as hip_mid→shoulder_mid, x_body as right_hip→left_hip (left minus right), z_body = x_body × y_body, then Gram-Schmidt/normalize to orthonormal basis. Ensure R_body_bed columns are x,y,z in bed coordinates.
Update metrics mapping (and any labels/variables) so flip uses x, twist uses y, side uses z; ideally compute explicit flip/twist/side counts for clarity.
next_actions: Patch BuildBodyFrameFromPose to align axis definitions and orthonormalization with the spec.
Adjust metrics display/counts mapping to match flip=x, twist=y, side=z.
Confirm axes visualization and quaternion/angles still use the updated basis.
